messages:
Caitlin M: Thanks for a packed all-hands — opening this follow-up for the Q&A items we didn't finish live. Short notes + owners below, please ack and add an ETA.

Devon H: Ack. I'll take the Dedicated SLA appendix edits (wording + two latency buckets). Will post a draft in SLA-901 by Tue.

Rajat S: I'll own the rollout canary gating criteria and the rollback checklist. Creating ROLL-901 now; ETA: Thursday.

Ana P: I'll assemble the canonical prompt sets Product mentioned and put them into redwood/evals. Product please add the top-3 model pins.

Legal Bot: Note: EU on-prem may need industry-specific addenda. Recommend case-by-case intake via LEGAL-102.

Caitlin M: Quick clarifications from leadership: public docs get high-level "targets" only; numeric P95s stay in contract appendices. Canary runs must use pinned model versions.

Devon H: Question: do we want separate targets for <=512 vs >512 tokens?

Caitlin M: Yes — two buckets. Please use 200ms P95 for small, 500ms P95 for large in the SLA appendix. Public copy should omit numbers.

Rajat S: Noted. I'll add canary pass criteria (perf + eval delta + KV cache sanity) to ROLL-901. Also scheduling a staging DR run next week.

Ana P: Product: PROD-121 please attach prompts + model pins by Fri so I can finalize eval suites.

eng-bot: Recording + slides uploaded: https://drive.redwood.com/all-hands/oct-2026  Recording: https://redwood.zoom.us/rec/share/zzzz9999 (internal)

Caitlin M: Action recap: Devon -> SLA-901 draft (Tue); Rajat -> ROLL-901 canary & rollback (Thu + DR run); Ana -> eval prompts assembly (waiting on PROD-121); Legal -> LEGAL-102 intake for EU addenda. Please reply with a short ETA or :white_check_mark: by EOD Monday. Closing this follow-up in 72h if no new asks.
